items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 56:1
items.html: When it speaks only of the aspect of the clothing of ZA upon the Tifferet of AA, it says that it clothes its lower third, for ZA has no share in the middle third of the Tifferet of AA, where Yeshsut clothes, as is known. But when it speaks of the aspect of the ascent of the NHY to the HGT, it cannot say that the lower third ascends to the two upper thirds of the Tifferet, for that is not so, because there are two phases of the screen of the Sium in the Tifferet: one from the aspect of the vessels, from whose aspect it stands in the place of the Tabur, which is the lower third of the Tifferet. The second is from the aspect of the lights, from whose aspect it stands in the place of the Chazeh, which is the two thirds of the Tifferet. And in order not to elaborate, it says simply that its lower half ascends into its upper half, that is, in the middle line, which is the Sium of the lights, the two lower thirds of the Tifferet ascend to the upper third of the Tifferet. And in the extremities, where there is the phase of the Sium of the vessels, only the lower third of the Tifferet ascends to the two upper thirds. Thus, taking both together, the ascent of the phase of the lower half of the Tifferet into the upper half is considered.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 56:2
items.html: (To the question) And as for what is said, that half of the Vav, which is the Tifferet of AA, was given to ZA (in Item 58), the intention is not that ZA clothes half of the Tifferet of AA; rather, the intention is that the HGT of Aba and Ima, from the aspect of the stature of AB that they attain for the need of the pregnancy of ZA, have in them two phases: one is the three lower thirds of the HGT that remained in their place and did not ascend to GAR. And the second phase is the three upper thirds of the NHY of AA that ascended and joined with them and became the HGT, as is known. And it says there that the higher phase of them, which are the three lower thirds of the HGT, is the portion of Aba and Ima, and ZA has no share in them. And the lower phase of them, which are the three upper thirds of the NHY of AA that ascended and became the HGT, are what become the GAR of ZA, which are the three Mochin KHB, because the Mochin of ZA are made only from the NHY, for ZA in its entirety is the phase of NHY, but from the phase of the NHY that ascended and became the HGT, in which case they are worthy of becoming a Rosh. But there is no mention whatsoever there of the aspect of clothing, for it is clear that ZA clothes only the lower third of the Tifferet of AA, as above. (Page 1041, beginning "And what").
